description: This file defines the ReadWriteLock class and associated LockGroup class for managing transaction locks within Orleans.Transactions. It implements lock acquisition, validation, rollback, and lock release logic, including concurrency handling with asynchronous operations and detailed logging.

classes.name: ReadWriteLock<TState>
classes.description: A generic transaction-aware read-write lock managing concurrent access, lock acquisition, validation, rollback, and release with support for lock groups, timeouts, and detailed logging.

classes.name: LockGroup
classes.description: A linked list node representing a group of transactions holding or waiting for the lock, including task management and deadlines.

methods.name: ReadWriteLock
methods.description: Constructor initializing the lock with options, queues, workers, logger, and activation lifecycle management.

methods.name: EnterLock<TResult>
methods.description: Asynchronously attempts to acquire the lock for a transaction, handling conflicts, re-entry, and executing the provided task upon success.

methods.name: ValidateLock
methods.description: Validates if a transaction's lock is still valid based on its recorded state and access counts.

methods.name: Notify
methods.description: Signals the lock worker to re-evaluate lock state and possibly process waiting transactions.

methods.name: TryGetRecord
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the transaction record associated with a given transaction ID.

methods.name: AbortExecutingTransactions
methods.description: Aborts all transactions currently executing in the active lock group, notifying relevant queues.

methods.name: Rollback
methods.description: Performs a rollback of a specific transaction, optionally notifying the queue.

methods.name: LockWork
methods.description: The core background task periodically evaluating lock timeout, group expiration, and initiating commit or abort operations.

methods.name: Find
methods.description: Locates an existing transaction group and record or creates a new group for a transaction.

methods.name: HasConflict
methods.description: Determines if a transaction conflicts with existing transactions in a group based on read/write modes and priorities.

methods.name: Conflicts
methods.description: Enumerates the transactions in a group that conflict with a given transaction.

methods.name: LockExits
methods.description: Checks if the current lock group can be exited, either by completing a single transaction or releasing multiple.

calls: Find(transactionId, isRead, out group, out record)
HasConflict(isRead, priority, transactionId, group, out var resolvable)
